description:
Get a campaign

One campaign by its id from /deals/campaigns, e.g. bonus:bauhaus-yapi-taksit-kampanyasi. Ended campaigns stay for 7 days, then 404.

GET /v1/deals/campaigns/{id} on Card Campaigns & Deals (SBX-FIRSAT). Costs 1 credit per call.
